risks.title: Deterioration in the value of the land reporting unit
risks.score_rationale: The land reporting unit experienced two goodwill impairments in 2025 (359M and 169.3M), indicating serious and repeated deterioration. The language used ('more likely than not', 'at risk since Q4 2024') reflects growing concern. 'Industrial' category is heavily weighted here.

risks.title: Exposure to derivatives and collateral
risks.score_rationale: Explicit mention of 'increased collateral requirements' related to derivative activities, impacting cash flows. Elevated risk in a context of fuel price and interest rate volatility. Central to operational cash flow dynamics.

risks.title: Unresolved tax disputes
risks.score_rationale: Unrecognized tax provisions of 95.9M$, with uncertainty regarding settlement timing. Reference to 'complex judgment' and risk of payment being 'materially different'. 'Litigation' category weighted by the magnitude of the amount.

risks.title: Customer receivables risk
risks.score_rationale: Allowance for credit losses based on uncertain estimates, particularly in difficult economic conditions. Statement that the allowance 'may not be sufficient'. Moderate but recurring risk.

risks.title: Integration of Universal TSS acquisition
risks.score_rationale: Major acquisition (207M$) completed in November 2025, with 60M$ still to be paid. Risk of integration failure or unrealized synergies, as highlighted in fair value estimates. 'Competition' category due to linkage with growth strategy.

risks.title: Equity volatility
risks.score_rationale: Explicit reference to 'volatility in market capitalization' affecting reporting unit values. Direct risk to impairment tests, especially for remaining goodwill (737.5M$ in total).

ai_positioning.summary: WKC does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F filing.
